source: main @ 67c7276 (the 2D Gate-0 build), detached worktree, R3D pre-flight step 9
notes: tick = the --seek-tick value; the frame is captured <frames> rendered frames after the seek (the sim keeps playing in real time, so the frame lands a few ticks later; a seek past an accent settles its gag, so the sneeze frame seeks to 1160 and plays through the accent at 1163).
frames is 10, not the 1 of the index: at --frames=1 DevShot captures an empty (all-zero) buffer, and the passive badges fade in over the first frames.

cmds/ holds the exact route command logs used (solve.sh --dump-cmds at 67c7276, route_hash = the solver's hash); on r3d the content task may re-plan N01/N02 routes (C1/C2), so replay these files when the ticks must match.
cast_sheet is the stage door Cast page scene, not a NightScene tick.
